finalStatus: RELEASE READY WITH KNOWN LOW-RISK ISSUES

calculators.details: All calculation engines (Life Path, Destiny Matrix, Name Numerology, Personal Year, Compatibility) perform deterministic, mathematically verified calculations with matching step-by-step arithmetic breakdown UI.

issues.issue: English Body Copy Leakage on Non-English Routes
issues.evidence: UI controls, navigation, and breadcrumbs are translated to Portuguese, but deep article body paragraphs in master data files (arcana.ts, birthdays.ts, numerology-content.ts) retain English source text.
issues.recommendedFix: Populate localized translation fields in master data structures for non-English locales or apply automated i18n translation pipelines to dataset strings.

content.details: Arcana (22), Birthday (365), and Numerology (288) pages are structurally and contentually differentiated using first-principles RHLF research. Banned AI buzzwords removed.

seo.details: DOCTYPE fixed to <!DOCTYPE html>. Canonicals, 40-locale hreflang tags, sitemap-index.xml (30,521 pages), and JSON-LD schemas (WebSite, WebApplication, BreadcrumbList, Article) fully validated.

design.details: Early-2000s Digital Occult Reference Library design system implemented with parchment palette (#FBF9F5), deep ink (#1C1625), deep violet (#231530), antique gold (#C4A052), classical serifs (Playfair Display, Cinzel, EB Garamond), and double borders.

accessibility.details: Semantic landmarks (<header>, <main>, <nav>, <footer>), form labels (htmlFor), high contrast ratios (> 7:1), and interactive language switcher ARIA attributes verified.
